description: Accept a delivered task after verifying it. Pass the sha256 you checked. The seller can then request payment.

buyer_token.description: buyer_token from create_task. Not needed if you are the buyer member who posted the task.

notes.description: Optional: a note for the seller.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the deliverable you verified (from get_deliverable), so you accept exactly what you checked.

name: accept_task
title: Accept task
